titleEn: I Want to Get In, Too

pages.text: The river had dropped far down. A boat rested on the sand. A brief shower overnight had left water inside.
Raju climbed in and picked up an oar. Sonu stood on tiptoe to look over the side. "I want to get in, too!"
Sonu clung to the boat's side, kicking little feet.
The boat tilted. Raju shouted, "Get down!"
Sonu plopped onto the sand and cried. Waaah!
Raju put down the oar and left. No one was in the boat.
Mom sat beside Sonu. "You wanted to join in. Shall we scoop out the water first?" Sonu wiped the tears.
Mina found a dipper beneath the boat. "You can scoop the water."
Raju returned and picked up the oar. All three sat inside: Sonu scooped, Raju wiped the oar, and Mina wound the rope.
